opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities delivering outstanding teaching; institutions may apply, not individual students.
opportunities.summary: Supports arts training for school‑age children under 18 outside regular school hours.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: Maximum total award £475,000; bursaries £5,000‑£10,000 per student per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or charities; university departments are not eligible; institutions may apply.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries for undergraduate and postgraduate students in fine and performing arts.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Up to £56,000 salary contribution year 1, £28,000 years 2‑3; up to £6,000 research expenses per annum

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not held a full‑time permanent academic post; must hold a doctorate; UK residency required.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships for early‑career researchers to undertake publishable work.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired or partially retired senior researchers in UK universities; must have UK residence and a record of research.
opportunities.summary: Supports retired researchers to complete a research project and prepare results for publication.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards up to £5 million each

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers; consortia of up to two universities may apply.
opportunities.summary: Supports up to 30 doctoral scholarships in interdisciplinary priority areas, plus post‑doctoral and programme costs.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million over up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (registered with Office for Students) with research degree awarding powers; can be single or collaborative centres.
opportunities.summary: Supports establishment of research centres for step‑change scholarship.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary costs (no fixed max) plus up to £6,000 research expenses per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Distinguished researchers in humanities or social sciences employed at a UK university; not required to be professor.
opportunities.summary: Two‑ or three‑year fellowships to complete original research.

opportunities.title: Philip Leverhulme Prizes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers with international impact; must hold a permanent UK university post; doctorate awarded ≤10 years ago (with possible career‑break extensions).
opportunities.summary: Prize for any research purpose, funded over 2‑3 years.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers in any discipline; must hold a UK university post and be resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: 3‑24 month fellowships to replace salary and cover research expenses.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK academic appointment, ≤2 years post‑PhD experience, and no prior large research team leadership.
opportunities.summary: Supports building a research team and leadership over 4‑5 years.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university host institution must coordinate; visiting professor from overseas; host institution must be eligible UK university.
opportunities.summary: Invites eminent overseas professor for 3‑12 month visit to enhance skills in an under‑represented research area.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other higher‑education institutions, and trial UK independent research institutes.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative original research projects up to five years.
